name: genpark-enterprise-slide-deck-narrative-compiler-skill
description: Enterprise Presentation & Slide Deck Narrative Structure Compiler (inspired by Tencent WorkBuddy Goal-to-PPT Workflows). Transforms raw enterprise documents, meeting transcripts, and KPI metrics into structured executive slide decks with layout templates, card callouts, speaker notes, and timing budgets.

tools.name: compile_slide_deck_narrative
tools.description: Compile enterprise goal-to-presentation deliverables: generate executive narrative outlines, assign slide layout archetypes, format card callouts, and compute presentation timing budgets.

raw_document_text.description: Raw source text, strategy document, or meeting transcript.
